In `_parse_markdown`, entities are processed by offset. The outer bold entity contains the italic and code entities, so it recursively formats its text as `"alpha _beta_ `gamma`"` and then wraps that in `*...*`, giving `*alpha _beta_ `gamma`*`. The italic and code entities are then skipped in the outer loop because they were added to `parsed_entities`. The URL entity adds plain `"delta"`, and the trailing non-entity text `" epsilon"` is appended at the end. So the returned `markdown_text` is the full string below.
